result.title: K-CLUE: A Segmentation-to-Clustering Framework for Ki67 Cell Typing
result.comment: Accepted at the BD-MedVis Workshop, BMVC 2026
result.summary: Ki67 is a key marker of tumor proliferation in breast cancer, but its quantification from immunohistochemistry images normally depends on supervised classifiers trained per dataset. We examine the role of frozen pretrained visual representations in annotation-free Ki67 cell typing. To this end, we use K-CLUE, a framework that segments individual nuclei, represents each nucleus with a pretrained encoder, reduces the resulting embeddings with principal component analysis, and separates Ki67-positive from Ki67-negative nuclei using k-means clustering, without task-specific training or manual annotations. Clustering the raw components is highly sensitive to the choice of encoder: across seven encoders, the Ki67-positive F1-score on matched MIST nuclei varies by 44 points, although Ki67 status remains linearly decodable from every representation, with supervised probe AUCs above 0.98. Analysis of the embedding spaces shows that clustering succeeds when DAB-related variation occupies the leading directions of variance. Whitening the retained principal components removes this dependence, reducing the spread across encoders to 1.00 F1-score point. Handcrafted color representations are also competitive, confirming that Ki67 status is strongly reflected in chromatic information, but they require an explicit choice of color space. In end-to-end evaluation, K-CLUE reaches F1-scores of 85.00% and 81.91% for Ki67-positive and Ki67-negative nuclei on MIST, and 79.59% and 81.16% on BCData, outperforming DeepLIIF and IHCScoreGAN on both datasets. These results show that pretrained representations can support annotation-free Ki67 typing when their variance structure is accounted for.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 K-CLUE：分割细胞核后用冻结预训练编码器表示、PCA 降维并以 k-means 区分 Ki67 阳性与阴性细胞，无需任务训练和标注；并发现跨编码器差异来自 DAB 相关变化是否占据主方差方向，用白化将其消除。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR/VLM 推理无直接联系，但其「线性可解码却不等于可无监督分离」「方差结构决定表征可用性」的诊断视角，可能为判断 latent 状态中任务相关视觉信息是否真正可被利用、是否发生信息坍缩提供评价类比，具体对应关系需较多核查。
